تتعجرفي (form IIq)
# تَتَعَجْرَفِي (tataʕajrafī) /ta.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تُتَعَجْرَفِي (tutaʕajrafī) /tu.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
